name: Shadow
author: Tyler Kamstra
provenance: Checked against the printed v2 player trait block in the PDFCoffee mirror.
sourceDistinctions: The playable trait box omits the encounter monster’s ability score loss and shadow creation. It grants poison immunity. Radiant vulnerability and necrotic resistance appear in the design discussion alone.
The Shadow can write and retains ordinary 0 HP rules. Rest healing is allowed under v2 p. 7. The supplement discusses optional repair spells, which this build does not require.

name: Blood Hawk
author: Tyler Kamstra
page: p. 224 in v2. Blood Hawk Traits.
provenance: Checked against the printed v2 player trait block in the PDFCoffee mirror.
sourceDistinctions: Kamstra’s awakened Beast has Small size and speaks Common. Pack Tactics requires a bonus action and covers only the next qualifying attack this turn.
The trait box explicitly grants finesse for Sneak Attack. This build wears no armor and does not rely on carried tools.

name: Flying Snake
author: Tyler Kamstra
page: p. 231 in v2. Flying Snake Traits.
provenance: Checked against the printed v2 player trait block in the PDFCoffee mirror.
sourceDistinctions: The printed player trait block grants 30-ft. flight and does not include Flyby. The design commentary mentions Flyby but adds no player trait.

V2 p. 7 makes bonus-action monk strikes conventional. Copper Sedge uses a short tail slap for the bonus unarmed strike, with the normal monk die and 5-ft. reach. For the split bite damage, this build adds Dexterity to piercing only.

name: Giant Centipede
author: Tyler Kamstra
page: p. 234 in v2. Giant Centipede Traits.
provenance: Checked against the printed v2 player trait block in the PDFCoffee mirror.
sourceDistinctions: The printed player trait block gives blindsight 60 ft. The design commentary mentions 30 ft. This profile follows the trait block.

Damage uses the player’s two dice and can supply a finesse Sneak Attack. The encounter entry’s paralysis rider does not apply. For the split bite damage, this build assigns Dexterity and Sneak Attack to piercing.
